description: Source code for Flask's application and request context management, including classes and functions for handling app contexts, request contexts, and related utilities.

classes.name: _AppCtxGlobals
classes.description: Namespace object for storing application context global data, accessible via 'g'.

classes.name: AppContext
classes.description: Represents an application context, managing request and app-specific data during request handling or CLI commands.

methods.name: after_this_request
methods.description: Decorator to register a function to run after the current request within the request context.

methods.name: copy_current_request_context
methods.description: Decorator to run a function within the current request context, useful for background tasks.

methods.name: has_request_context
methods.description: Checks if a request context is active.

methods.name: has_app_context
methods.description: Checks if an application context is active.
